info.name: Learnly API
info.description: Demo of the Learnly REST API (lab 3). Run it against a freshly seeded server: `npm run db:reset`, `npm run dev`, then `npm run test:postman`. Variables live in learnly.postman_environment.json; switch `locale` between uk and en to see every message in the other language. The OpenAPI document of the same API is at /api/docs.

item.name: Demo flow
item.description: Instructor creates a course and submits it; an administrator approves it; the catalog contains it; a student enrolls, completes a lesson, passes the quiz and leaves a review. Every run uses a new course.
